import numpy as np

def diffusion_training_step(x_0, model, alpha_bar, num_steps):
    t = np.random.randint(0, num_steps)
    epsilon = np.random.randn(*x_0.shape)
    x_t = np.sqrt(alpha_bar[t]) * x_0 + np.sqrt(1 - alpha_bar[t]) * epsilon
    epsilon_pred = model(x_t, t)
    mse_loss = np.mean((epsilon - epsilon_pred) ** 2)
    return mse_loss, t, x_t, epsilon_pred
